description: Registry of literature DFT reference datasets used by the mliport literature benchmark (T9). Only provenance, checksums, licences and import rules live here; raw data is never committed unless a dataset is explicitly marked redistributable.

cache.policy: downloaded raw data and imported reference structures are cache artifacts; they are ignored by git and are never required for CPU-only tests

comparison_taxonomy.reference_matched: the model and the reference were produced at the same level of theory (same functional/pseudopotentials/settings) and absolute energies are comparable
comparison_taxonomy.cross_method: the reference uses a different functional/settings than the model's training level; absolute energies are NOT compared, only forces, relative energies inside a group, geometry and rankings

lips25.title: Li-P-S Electrolyte Materials as a Benchmark for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials (LiPS-25)
lips25.citation: N. L. Fragapane, V. L. Deringer, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 22, 3646-3659 (2026), doi:10.1021/acs.jctc.5c02006; dataset: LiPS-25 v1.0.0, https://github.com/nfragapane/lips-25
lips25.comparison_note: The reference is PBEsol; the production MACE/DPA/UMA/GRACE checkpoints are PBE(+U) foundation models, so absolute total energies are never compared. Forces, formation energies along the Li2S-P2S5 tie line (a difference of reference totals at the same level) and relative energies within one composition are compared and labelled cross-method.

paper.evidence: Crossref licence metadata for doi:10.1021/acs.jctc.5c02006 (content-version vor)

data.evidence: https://github.com/nfragapane/lips-25 at commit 78c7bfa8 publishes data and code but carries no LICENSE file (only CITATION.cff and README.md instruct citation); the article's CC-BY-4.0 licence does not automatically extend to the repository data. Treated as 'no explicit data licence'.

license.policy: fetch at run time into the local cache; never copy raw LiPS-25 files into the mliport git repository

relaxation.cell: variable cell (ExpCellFilter in the reference notebook)

units.energy: eV, total per cell (extxyz keys dft_energy / energy)
units.virial: eV, 9 components in extxyz 'virial'; the sign and normalisation convention is not documented by the dataset, so it is imported as provenance only and is never converted to stress

task1_relaxed.description: Task 1: ten DFT-relaxed crystals along the x Li2S-(1-x) P2S5 tie line (P2S5, Li2P2S6, Li4P2S7, Li7P3S11, alpha/beta/gamma-Li3PS4, high-T and low-T Li7PS6, Li2S), energy and forces

task1_unrelaxed.description: Task 1 input structures before DFT relaxation (no labels); used for MLIP relaxation and volume/lattice comparison against task1_relaxed

task2_mq.description: Task 2: 35 DFT single points sampled every 5 ps from a NequIP-driven melt-quench trajectory of a 672-atom Li7P3S11 supercell (300-1500 K); energy and forces

test.description: Official LiPS-25 test split: 1256 structures over 39 iterated-training strata (crystalline to glassy), energy and forces

data_overlap.note: LiPS-25 was released in 2026, after the public foundation-model checkpoints evaluated here; overlap with their training corpora is therefore unlikely but was not independently verified. The dataset's own published test split is used.

lips20.title: EGraFFBench: evaluation of equivariant graph neural network force fields for atomistic simulations (LiPS20 dataset)
lips20.citation: V. Bihani et al., Digital Discovery 3, 759-768 (2024), doi:10.1039/D4DD00027G; dataset: M3RG-IITD/MDBENCHGNN, Datasets/All_LiPS20
lips20.comparison_note: PBE-D3/CP2K total energies are not comparable with any foundation-model absolute energy; only forces and within-composition relative energies are interpreted. Absolute energy-per-atom numbers are recorded as diagnostics with an explicit non-comparability flag.

data.evidence: https://github.com/M3RG-IITD/MDBENCHGNN at commit e4ee1e90 ships a LICENSE file that is empty (1 byte, no licence text) and a README with no data licence statement. Treated as 'no explicit data licence'.

license.policy: fetch at run time into the local cache; never copy raw LiPS20 arrays into the mliport git repository

aimd.note: 3000 K was chosen to sample melting; the same trajectory supplies crystal, glass and liquid-like configurations

units.virial: DeePMD virial.npy in eV; the dataset ships no stress label and the paper does not document the virial sign/normalisation, so the array is verified, hashed and recorded but NEVER converted to stress

lips20_3000k.description: 20 compositions (crystalline Li2S, Li3P, beta/gamma-Li3PS4, Li2PS3, Li4P2S6, Li2P2S6, Li7P3S11, Li7PS6, Li48P16S61; glasses g67/g70/g75/g80; pure Li, P, S, P2S5, P4S3), 1000 AIMD frames each

data_overlap.note: LiPS20 predates the foundation-model corpora and shares Materials Project-derived crystal structures; treat crystal rows as possible-overlap and glass/liquid rows as more external. The status is recorded per record; it does not change the metric definitions.

omat24.title: Meta Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) validation split, pinned 256-structure subset
omat24.citation: L. Barroso-Luque et al., Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) Inorganic Materials Dataset and Models, arXiv:2410.12771 (2024); dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/OMAT24
omat24.comparison_note: The production checkpoints were trained on OMat24, so its validation split is the only reference-matched absolute-energy comparison in this suite. The 256-structure subset is already pinned and committed by the existing harness (validation/science/data/omat24_subset.extxyz); T9 reuses it instead of re-downloading anything.

license.policy: the pinned 256-structure subset is committed by the existing harness with provenance in validation/science/data_manifest.json

dft.note: see the OMat24 dataset card for the full settings; the harness never mixes these energies with other reference levels

units.note: the official validation LMDB carries no stress labels

val256.description: the existing pinned 256-structure stratified validation subset (4 strata x 64)

data_overlap.note: drawn only from the official validation split of the corrected 2024-12-20 files, so none of these structures are training data (see data_manifest.json)

jarvis.title: JARVIS-DFT 3D dataset (jdft_3d)
jarvis.citation: K. Choudhary et al., The joint automated repository for various integrated simulations (JARVIS) for data-driven materials design, npj Comput. Mater. 6, 173 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41524-020-00440-1; JARVIS-DFT 3D dataset v11, doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.6815699
jarvis.comparison_note: OptB88vdW total energies are not comparable with PBE(+U) foundation-model energies. JARVIS is therefore used for (a) relative energies between polymorphs of one formula (group-mean removed) and (b) structure/volume checks after relaxation, never for absolute energy errors and never for forces (the dataset carries none).

data.evidence: figshare article 6815699 licence field: CC BY 4.0

license.policy: downloadable archive; imported subsets live in the local cache (the 254 MB JSON is never committed)

dft.per_entry_settings: each record carries its own encut (650/1000/1100 eV in the published data) and k-point density; the importer copies encut_eV, func and jid into every imported structure so heterogeneous settings are never averaged silently

polymorphs.description: deterministic selection of formula groups with several polymorphs (2-24 atoms) from the 93902-entry JARVIS-DFT 3D database; relative energies inside each formula group are compared, absolute energies are never

data_overlap.note: JARVIS-DFT structures are derived in part from Materials Project; overlap with foundation-model training corpora cannot be excluded, and because only relative energies and geometries are used the residual risk is recorded rather than hidden

ms25.title: MS25: Materials Science-Focused Benchmark Data Set for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
ms25.citation: T. Maxson et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model. (2025), doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.5c01262; data: doi:10.18126/6w8c-by76 (Materials Data Facility)
ms25.reference_level: as documented per MS25 subset (MgO surfaces, liquid water, zeolites, Pt surface reaction, HEAs, disordered Zr-O)
ms25.comparison_note: The MS25 DFT settings are documented per subset in the paper (closed access at retrieval time), so the per-subset functional/software must be recorded by the user manifest before any comparison; the importer refuses to run without that metadata.

paper.evidence: Crossref licence metadata for doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.5c01262 (stm-asf policies, not an open licence)

data.evidence: doi:10.18126/6w8c-by76 resolves to a Materials Data Facility landing page with no rights statement in the DataCite metadata (rightsList empty) and download requires the MDF/Globus client

license.policy: local import only; no automatic download and no redistribution

provenance.access: blocked: the MDF landing page is a client-side application and the data requires Globus/MDF authentication, which this harness does not automate

dft.software: not verified (paper closed access at retrieval time)
dft.note: must be supplied in the local import manifest; the harness records it verbatim and refuses an unlabelled comparison

units.stress: eV/Angstrom^3 (ASE Voigt), only when the supplied file has a verified stress label

data_overlap.note: not evaluated because the data could not be acquired

local_import.note: see validation/science/literature/README.md section 'MS25 and other user-supplied references'
